jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Operations
jobs.why: Outstanding healthcare-operations and systems fit in oncology tech. The role combines strategic initiatives, dashboards and reporting, process standardization, change management, transformation roadmaps, resource planning, governance, and AI/automation opportunities across business teams.
jobs.gap: The role expects strong strategy/operations ownership and comfort with quantitative analysis and modern low-code/no-code AI automation tools. Emphasize healthcare operations, business analysis, reporting, workflow automation, cross-functional project delivery, and practical AI adoption without overstating technical depth.

jobs.title: Healthcare Operations Manager
jobs.why: Direct healthcare-operations management role with responsibility for facility performance, clinical goal support, quality improvement, team leadership, and operational execution. The Brooklyn location and management requirements align well with healthcare operations experience.
jobs.gap: Dialysis/renal operations are specialized and the role may favor candidates with direct facility leadership experience. Emphasize healthcare operations, staff training, process improvement, compliance, patient-service workflows, and team coordination.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Excellent direct healthcare-practice operations fit covering workflow improvement, KPIs and dashboards, staffing, patient access, project implementation, change management, revenue-cycle workflows, cross-functional coordination, and operational performance.
jobs.gap: The position expects several years of healthcare-delivery operations and staff leadership plus familiarity with clinical and revenue-cycle systems. Emphasize ABA/healthcare operations, training, intake workflows, reporting, process redesign, and systems/project experience.

jobs.title: Operations
jobs.why: Strong growth-stage healthcare-operations role focused on insurance workflows, process design, operational scaling, automation, and hands-on execution. Silna also works across behavioral health and ABA-related authorization workflows, making the domain overlap unusually relevant.
jobs.gap: The role is broad and likely expects startup-style ownership, fast execution, and comfort designing processes from scratch. Emphasize healthcare intake/authorization operations, workflow automation, process documentation, reporting, and cross-functional execution.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Care Management
jobs.location: United States · Remote including New York
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare systems implementation match involving clinical and business requirements, workflow design, configuration, UAT, go-live, governance, reporting, process improvement, vendor coordination, and cross-functional delivery across clinical, IT, and operations teams.
jobs.gap: The role asks for technology implementation and AI-related experience. Lead with Power Automate/SharePoint and other workflow/system projects, reporting, business analysis, healthcare operations, training, and practical AI adoption without presenting as a software engineer.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Up to 25% travel
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare-AI implementation role covering onboarding, workflow interviews, configuration, testing, training, go-live, KPI measurement, change management, SOPs, and cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Sales, and healthcare customers.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch requiring 5–7 years in healthcare and 4+ years directly owning healthcare IT or SaaS implementations. Emphasize transferable healthcare operations, workflow redesign, systems projects, training, documentation, and stakeholder management without inflating implementation tenure.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.why: Strong NYC health-tech implementation role owning customer onboarding and go-lives, project plans, cross-functional coordination, workflow integration, customer communication, and operational execution for cancer-center deployments.
jobs.gap: EMR-integrated clinical-trial deployments and oncology workflows are specialized. Emphasize healthcare project coordination, system adoption, training, workflow mapping, reporting, and stakeholder management while being clear about direct EMR integration depth.

jobs.title: Clinical Speciality Programs & Operations Manager - NY
jobs.why: Strong clinical-operations role designing SOPs, referral and intake workflows, operational playbooks, KPIs, capacity models, and scalable care-delivery infrastructure while partnering with clinical, finance, product, and growth teams.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 5+ years of healthcare operations, strong financial/P&L ownership, EHR depth, and Lean/Six Sigma experience. Emphasize healthcare intake, operations, training, process improvement, dashboards, and workflow design without claiming certifications not held.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.why: Good healthcare SaaS implementation fit owning enterprise onboarding, multiple concurrent projects, client communication, process improvement, configuration workflows, and collaboration with GTM, Product, and Engineering.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 5+ years leading complex SaaS implementations and familiarity with APIs/integrations. Treat as a moderate stretch and emphasize systems implementation, project management, workflow automation, documentation, and healthcare operations.

jobs.title: Manager of Operations
jobs.location: New York Metro / Long Island · Multi-site travel
jobs.why: Direct multi-site healthcare operations role covering daily operations, practice integration, operational and financial performance, KPI reporting, process improvement, resource allocation, and collaboration with clinical and administrative teams.
jobs.gap: The role likely expects deeper multi-site practice-management and financial ownership than the current profile. Emphasize healthcare operations, staff coordination, performance reporting, process improvement, implementation, and cross-functional leadership while treating multi-site P&L ownership as the key stretch.
